WITH per_currency AS (
  SELECT
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS mean_avg_rebtotal
  FROM per_currency
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_rebtotal) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal,
  AVG(p.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_of_avg_relative_gap,
  AVG(p.avg_rebtotal - b.mean_avg_rebtotal) AS avg_excess_rebtotal
FROM per_currency AS p
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE b.mean_avg_rebtotal IS NOT NULL
  AND p.avg_rebtotal > b.mean_avg_rebtotal;
